metadataRaw.title: How to INSTANTLY Relieve Jaw Pain
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows easy exercises that may help instantly relieve jaw (and TMJ) pain, even within 30 seconds.

Major causes of jaw pain are due to tightness in the muscles of mastication (the chewing muscles) and jaw tracking issues. 

This video will focus on quickly fixing these issues for maximum jaw pain relief.

Each exercise works differently. To get the best results, go through them all and use what gives you the most relief.

Chapters: 
0:00 Intro
0:22 The Bulldog
2:10 Pen Method
4:21 Masseter Muscle Release
6:16 Temporalis Muscle Release
7:34 Jaw Tracking (for TMJ!)
